name: The Williams Companies, Inc.
blurb: Williams Companies is the largest natural-gas-focused midstream infrastructure company in the United States, operating the Transco pipeline — the nation's highest-volume natural-gas transmission system, running 1,800 miles from Texas to New York — along with gathering, processing, and deepwater assets. Unlike diversified midstream peers such as Energy Transfer or Kinder Morgan, Williams has deliberately concentrated its portfolio on natural gas at a moment when data-center electricity demand has made gas the critical bridge fuel for AI infrastructure build-out.
recent: Williams' market capitalization has surged approximately 90% over two years to nearly $90 billion — the highest among U.S. pipeline operators — as AI-driven electricity demand has elevated natural-gas infrastructure to near-strategic-asset status. CEO Chad Zamarin described current conditions as 'definitely an upcycle,' with infrastructure representing the critical bottleneck as data-center load grows. The company targets 10% or higher compound annual EBITDA growth from 2026 to 2030 and announced $7.3 billion in power-generation projects in Ohio and Utah to position itself as a 'one-stop shop' for hyperscaler power supply — combining gas transportation with direct electricity generation for customers like Meta.
